# Colab Notebooks {#sec-notebooks}

Every chapter has a companion Python notebook. The notebooks run in [Google Colab](https://colab.research.google.com), a free service that runs Python in your web browser, so you don't need to install anything.

## Getting started with Colab

1. Click an **Open in Colab** badge below and sign in with a Google account.
2. Choose **File → Save a copy in Drive** so your changes are saved to your own copy.
3. Run a cell with **Shift + Enter**. Run cells top to bottom the first time.
4. If something breaks, use **Runtime → Restart session and run all**.

::: {.callout-tip title="No Google account?"}
Click **Download .ipynb** instead and open the file in [Jupyter](https://jupyter.org), VS Code, or Cursor.
:::
